leaked_early.details: Idenix was a frequent subject of takeover speculation since early 2012, with rumors involving multiple Big Pharma companies. In the weeks leading up to the announcement, there was speculation of a bidding war involving Merck, J&J, and AbbVie.

notes: Merck significantly outbid competitors (final offer $24.50 vs. Party A's $19.75) to secure Idenix's HCV assets, driven by promising Phase 1/2 data for IDX-21437 and a desire to compete with Gilead's Sovaldi.
